Track 2 — For small businesses

Customers check two things. Most small businesses fail both.

First they search for a business like yours. Then they search for the owner. If either search comes up empty — or wrong — the call goes to someone else. This applies in every niche: trades, services, health, food, retail, professional — any local business.

1 — YOUR BUSINESS

“[Your service] near me”

If you're missing from Yelp, BBB, Thumbtack and 40+ other sites — or your phone and address are different on each one — Google doesn't trust you, and customers never see you.

  • Missing listings = missing calls
  • Wrong name / address / phone = split trust
  • Fix: 50 listings, one correct NAP everywhere
2 — YOUR NAME

“[Your name] + your trade”

Before a big purchase or booking, customers Google the owner. If nothing professional comes up — no LinkedIn, no Crunchbase, no real profile — you look risky, even if your work is excellent.

  • No personal presence = no personal authority
  • Competitor owners who show up look more established
  • Fix: 10 personal profiles — same name, photo & bio

Why this works — in simple words

Listings prove a business is real. Personal profiles prove the owner is real. Together, that's trust — and trust is what wins the job, in any niche.

  • Same NAP everywhere = Google trusts you

    NAP = Name, Address, Phone. When it's identical on 50 sites, Google gets 50 confirmations the business is real — and trusted businesses are easier to find on Maps and search.

  • Missing = invisible. Wrong = harmful.

    Missing on Yelp or BBB means customers there never find the business. Wrong NAP splits trust, sends customers to a wrong number or address, and can even hide a Google profile.

  • Owners close big jobs — not logos

    A customer paying for a big job or service wants to trust a person. When the owner's name brings up LinkedIn, Crunchbase and consistent profiles with a photo, they look established before the first call.

  • Everything is checkable

    Every job — agency or direct — comes with a live links sheet. Click every link yourself. No black box, no “trust me” — proof you can open.

Straight answers

Questions agencies and business owners ask before they start.

For agencies

Will my client ever know you did the work?

No. Everything is delivered under your brand — the live links sheet carries your agency's name, and I never contact your client directly. As far as your client is concerned, your team did the work.

What do you charge, and what can I charge?

One price for everyone: 50 listings cost $99 per client, delivered in 3 days with a sheet of live links. Most agencies retail that at $300–500 to their client and keep about 67–80%. You set your own retail price — I never quote your client anything.

Can I test you with one client first?

Yes — that's the normal start. One test client at $99: 50 listings under your brand, live links sheet in 3 days, no monthly commitment. If the work is right, send the next client.

What do you need from me to start?

Your client's correct business name, address and phone (their NAP), exactly as it should appear everywhere. I handle the building and verification from there and send you the live links sheet.

For small businesses

What exactly is a personal entity?

It's you, the owner, set up properly online: 10 profiles — LinkedIn, Facebook, Crunchbase, About.me, X, Instagram, Alignable, Bark, Thumbtack, plus a Google Knowledge Panel request — all with the same name, photo and bio. When a customer searches your name, they find a real, established owner instead of nothing.

What do you need from me for personal profiles?

Just three things: a clear photo of you, a short bio (I can help you write it), and your permission to create the profiles. You get every login, and you own every profile.

Is the Google Business Profile included?

Yes — a basic GBP fix (category, services, hours, key details) is included inside every package. It's supporting work, not the main sell. The main sell is listings + personal entity, because that's what most small businesses are actually missing.

Do you guarantee the #1 spot on Google?

No — nobody honest can. What I guarantee is the work itself: 50 correct live listings and/or 10 consistent personal profiles, delivered with a live links sheet and logins you can check yourself.

Do you buy reviews or post fake ones?

Never. Fake reviews can get a profile suspended. I help you ask real customers for real reviews and reply to reviews properly under Monthly Care.

How do I pay?

By Payoneer. You'll get an invoice and a Payoneer payment link by email — pay by card from the link (no Payoneer account needed) or by US bank transfer to my Payoneer US receiving account. One-time packages have no contract; Monthly Care is month-to-month.

Do I own everything?

Yes. Your listings access, your personal profiles, your Google profile and all logins belong to you and your business. Agencies: the same applies to your client — everything is handed over in the delivery sheet. If we stop working together, everything stays with you.

Can I do the listings myself using the Workbook?

Yes. The Business Listings Workbook is a free 62-page Google Doc written so a new business owner can follow it alone — with real screenshots for Brownbook, Manta and Hotfrog, a master info sheet, a tracker, and a chapter on adding social profiles. If you would rather not spend the time, I can build all 50 listings for you.
